Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Seahurst Nightstand, 30"W, Grey Taupe
Colors: Grey Taupe Wood
Materials: Acrylic
Make your evenings even more serene with this grey-taupe nightstand. No bedroom set is complete without a nightstand of similar style and quality—it turns a bed into a bower. 30"W x 18"D x 29"H Grey-taupe finish, oak veneers, rubberwood solids, nickel acrylic hardware The casual contemporary style of this collection makes it the perfect addition or update to your bedroom. Two drawers with plenty of storage for any bedside essentials. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
